payload.rebuttal: fixed: The rescan test iterated `sorted(DEPENDENCY_WAITING_STATES)` to build its five waiting-state cases, so shrinking that constant also shrank the test's own coverage and the dropped state went undriven. Replaced the loop with a hardcoded five-state set, asserted equal to the real constant before the loop runs, so a future shrink fails that assertion and the loop still drives all five states regardless.
